features.heading: Why 10,000+ Traders Trust CryptoTax
features.subheading: Professional tax calculation for all crypto traders. Automatic, precise, compliant.

ai.title: AI-Powered Automation
ai.description: No more Excel chaos! Our AI engine automatically analyzes all your crypto transactions and calculates precisely using FIFO, LIFO, or custom methods. Supports all transaction types: trades, staking, mining, airdrops, DeFi, NFTs and more. Fully compliant with tax regulations.

exchanges.title: 100+ Exchanges & Wallets
exchanges.description: Seamlessly connect over 100 crypto exchanges and wallets - from Binance, Coinbase, Kraken to DeFi protocols like Uniswap and Aave. Automatic CSV import, API integration or manual entry - you decide. Our intelligent duplicate detection ensures every transaction is counted only once.

security.title: Bank-Level Security
security.description: We take data privacy seriously. End-to-end encryption with bank-grade standards (AES-256), zero-knowledge architecture and servers in Germany (GDPR compliant). We don't store API keys, all sensitive data is processed client-side. Regular security audits by independent experts.

reports.title: Tax-Office Ready Reports
reports.description: Generate tax-recognized reports in seconds in PDF or Excel format. Our reports meet all requirements of tax authorities and include all necessary information: acquisition time, acquisition costs, disposal time, proceeds and profit/loss. Direct export for tax filing.
reports.bullet1: PDF & Excel export for tax office

realtime.title: Real-Time Updates
realtime.description: Synchronize your portfolios in real-time via API connections. New transactions are automatically imported and processed. Live dashboard shows you your current tax status at any time: unrealized gains, holding periods, optimal selling times. Smart alerts warn you of tax-unfavorable trades.

multiyear.title: Multi-Year & Multi-Currency
multiyear.description: Manage unlimited tax years in one tool. Automatic carryover of holdings, correct handling of carry-forward losses. Supports 150+ fiat currencies and automatic conversion at historical exchange rates. Perfect for international traders: multi-jurisdiction support with country-specific tax rules.
